in_marathi.name: Manmatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manmatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manmatha is the name of the Hindu god of love, desire, and attraction. He is depicted as a youthful, handsome figure riding a chariot pulled by bees, which represents love and desire.
